# uiGradients vector backgrounds

This pack adapts 148 visually reviewed color palettes from [uiGradients](https://github.com/ghosh/uiGradients) into scalable SVG linear-gradient backgrounds. The palette source has 382 entries; the selection favors useful variation across light, dark, warm, cool, soft, saturated, seasonal and neutral colors. These are color backgrounds, not seamless repeat tiles, so Studio registers them as elements in the Backgrounds category.

- Pinned source revision: [`afb018418e92c3fa4048daa88eb6525a78f5486e`](https://github.com/ghosh/uiGradients/tree/afb018418e92c3fa4048daa88eb6525a78f5486e).
- Original palette data: `gradients.json`, preserved verbatim. `selected-indices.json` identifies each chosen record; `SOURCE-MANIFEST.json` records its exact name, colors, source index, revision and hashes.
- Rights: [MIT license](https://github.com/ghosh/uiGradients/blob/afb018418e92c3fa4048daa88eb6525a78f5486e/LICENSE.md), original notice preserved verbatim in `LICENSE.md`. Commercial use, modification and redistribution are permitted with the copyright and permission notice. Studio metadata carries the notice and requires attribution.
- Attribution: uiGradients is community contributed. Its palette JSON does not identify individual contributors. The repository is maintained by Indrashish Ghosh, named in the bundled MIT notice. We do not attribute individual palettes to him without evidence.
- Regenerate: `node scripts/ingest-uigradients.mjs`. The generator checks the pinned data and license hashes, validates every selected color, and verifies that each normalized SVG renders. Gradient direction and SVG framing are SweetOh adaptations of the original color sequences.

The names and source colors remain traceable. The search tags describe a palette's visible color mood and general design use; culturally specific meanings are not inferred from a palette's name.
